table_stability_findings: CustomPayrollTable derives --payroll-font-size-base, --payroll-header-font-size, padding, and --payroll-row-height from tableContainerWidth and fontSize.
ResizeObserver observes both container and table; table size changes can feed back into width/scale calculation.
Scroll handler updates active chapter and active gang marker using DOM measurements.
CSS data-active-group and data-focus-dim selectors alter font weight, color, shadow, and highlight during active chapter changes.
Gang sticky row top uses calc(4 * --payroll-row-height), so rowHeight changes can make gang headers move.
Table shell uses calc(100vh - 120px); this can clash with parent layout when toolbar/filter height changes.
constraints: Do not overwrite existing uncommitted changes.
Do not remove table features such as edit mode, focus navigation, sticky headers, or horizontal chapter navigation without replacement.
Scroll must not trigger typography/color/height changes in table body cells.
